cards.name: Bin Chicken
cards.oracleText:
You may treat Food tokens as though they were Junk tokens and vice versa.
When this creature enters, choose one—
* Create a Food Token.
* Amass Birds X, where X is the number of Foods you control.
{3}{B}{B}, Exile an artifact card from your graveyard: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
